channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Give your AI agent a PhD supervisor: a hands-on guide to Supervisor-Skills
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: HKUST's 10,100-star Supervisor-Skills distills a decade of PhD-advisor publishing experience into installable AI skills for research: idea evaluation, introduction drafting, literature surveys, and paper polishing. This guide installs the skills in your coding agent and walks the full idea-to-submission loop hands-on.

item.title: DHS shuts DeepSeek out of federal civilian systems — and everything built on its models
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: DHS made public its order excluding DeepSeek — and any third-party product built on its models — from federal civilian procurements and IT systems, citing data-transfer and malware risks.

item.title: FLUX 3 Max: fal and Black Forest Labs push image-to-video to 1,139 Elo — in 11 seconds flat
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: fal and Black Forest Labs launched FLUX 3 Max, a video generation model hitting 1,139 Elo on the Artificial Analysis Video Arena — 22x faster than Seedance 2.5 and 11.5x faster than FLUX 3, at 75% off for three weeks.

item.title: Bill Gross launches Idealab.ai: 1.2 million AI-generated business ideas, free to everyone
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Idealab founder Bill Gross has launched Idealab.ai, a free platform with more than 1.2 million AI-generated business ideas drawn from 17 million sources — betting AI can create entrepreneurs, not just eliminate jobs.

item.title: Dream Labs raises $90M to build the brain for everyday robots: Dream-1 turns plain English into motor commands
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Ex-NVIDIA robotics researchers unveil Dream-1, a robot foundation model trained on videos of people doing everyday tasks — plus Dream API, the first public API that turns a camera feed and a plain-English instruction into motor commands on hardware it has never seen.

item.title: Inception's Mercury 3: the diffusion LLM that beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at 1,068 tokens per second
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Inception's Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion language model ever released: over 40x the size of Mercury 1, a 1-million-token context window, and 4-8x faster than the frontier speed-optimized models it outperforms - from $0.10 per million input tokens at launch.

item.title: Teach your agent to rewire itself: a hands-on guide to Google's Harness²
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google's Harness² is a plug-and-play framework that recursively improves the system around a model — prompts, tools, memory, skills — while the weights stay fixed. This guide runs its credential-free local demo, then a real benchmark task end to end.

item.title: Cognizant and Google Cloud launch a Gemini Frontier Capability Group: 18,000 engineers to take agentic AI from pilot to production
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cognizant and Google Cloud announced on October 19, 2026 a major expansion of their partnership, creating a Gemini Frontier Capability Group backed by more than 18,000 dedicated engineers to deploy production-grade AI agents on Gemini.

item.title: doubleAI launches Maxwell: Amnon Shashua’s "code execution model" makes software faster while it runs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: doubleAI, the new AI venture from Mobileye founder Amnon Shashua, unveiled Code Execution Models on October 19, 2026 — AI that lives inside running software and optimizes its execution. Its first model, Maxwell, is now in early access.

item.title: Rushil Goel launches Mandl: an AI-native insurance company built on Nirvana's $300M engine
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Mandl launched on October 19, 2026, backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed, and Valor Equity Partners, to rebuild commercial insurance with AI-native companies — starting from Nirvana's $300M premium engine, Vega's 4x-faster claims, and Cooper's AI operations platform.

item.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: the anonymous 'Space Bunny' unmasked as a 3x-faster, 70%-cheaper agent model
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: MiniMax officially rolled out M3.1 Flash on October 19, 2026, confirming the anonymous 'Space Bunny' model was an early build: nearly triple the online inference speed, 70% lower agentic-task costs, and flat API pricing of $0.15 per million input tokens.

item.title: Axonius AI Workforce: 50+ virtual workers that own security outcomes — and ask permission first
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Axonius announced the AI Workforce today: 50+ types of virtual security workers that monitor IT environments, remediate exposures, and escalate sensitive actions to human approval — all grounded in the company’s unified Asset Cloud.

item.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5B at $6.2B valuation: Jim Keller's RISC-V bet against Nvidia scales up
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Tenstorrent has closed a $1.5B Series E at a $6.2B post-money valuation, led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, to scale its RISC-V Galaxy servers for the open-model era.

item.title: Render text-perfect images on your own GPU: a hands-on guide to MOSS-Image
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image (867 stars on 2026-10-19, Apache-2.0) is a 5B-parameter open image model that renders legible text in pictures — posters, whiteboards, sticky notes — and pins text and objects to exact positions with JSON layouts. Released 2026-10-16 with Base and SFT weights, it runs on your own GPU via diffusers, Gradio, ComfyUI, SGLang or vLLM-Omni. Hands-on: the install, your first generation, the recommended sampling settings, layout-controlled posters, and the prompt-enhancer skill.

item.title: Third Partners launches 3P/AI: agentic AI that automates sustainability reporting, three weeks before California's SB 253 deadline
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Boutique consultancy Third Partners opened a public beta of 3P/AI on October 19, 2026 — agentic AI tools that automate sustainability reporting and benchmark companies against competitors, just as California's first SB 253 filings come due.

item.title: MemSilicon raises $60M Series A to build RRAM compute-in-memory chips for AI inference — ex-Graphcore chief takes the helm
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Chinese chip startup MemSilicon closed a Series A of more than 400 million yuan (about $60M) on October 19, 2026, led by Boyuan Capital, to industrialize RRAM compute-in-memory technology and build a first-generation LPU for large-model inference — and named former Graphcore Greater China chief Lu Tao as CEO and co-founder.

item.title: GTIA launches the Managed Intelligence Alliance: 9 founding members set out to standardize AI delivery through the IT channel
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GTIA launched the vendor-neutral Managed Intelligence Alliance on October 19, 2026 — with Pax8 as charter member and Microsoft and CrowdStrike among nine founding members — to set open standards for how IT providers deliver AI to SMBs.

item.title: Ultima Genomics wins UK Biobank immune study: UG200 to profile 80,000 immune systems for an AI-scale dataset
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Ultima Genomics' UG200 sequencing platform will power an IMU Biosciences–UK Biobank study profiling 80,000 blood samples — over 100 million immune data points per sample — into a foundational dataset for AI, with room to grow to the full 500,000-participant cohort.

item.title: GoTo releases a 27B open-weights model that speaks Indonesia's regional languages: Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese and Batak Toba
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Indonesia's GoTo Group released a 27-billion-parameter open-weights language model tuned for Bahasa Indonesia and four regional languages, announced October 19 at Bali Tech Week.

item.title: Stop queueing your agents' commits: a hands-on guide to gitai, Git rebuilt for AI agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: feder-cr/git-ai (2,321 stars in its first four days, MIT) is an open-source implementation of Anthropic's Scion design: a server-centric Git where coding agents land changes with compare-and-swap instead of merge queues — 1,862–2,544 lands per minute in its benchmark versus 240–272 the classic way. Hands-on: the build, the quickstart demo, landing changes as two agents with a policy denial, and reading history without cloning.

item.title: The AI selloff crosses the Pacific: Nikkei drops 2%, Kospi sinks 3% as data-center debt fears spread
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell about 2% and South Korea's Kospi dropped as much as 3.2% intraday on Monday as the AI infrastructure selloff spread from Wall Street to Asia — driven by CoreWeave's credit scare and growing questions over data-center debt.

item.title: 10,000 patients, one drop of blood: Early Signal Diagnostics bets its AI cancer test on a Bogotá validation study
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Early Signal Diagnostics will validate its AI-driven blood test for ovarian and pancreatic cancer in 10,000 patients across two Bogotá laboratories starting in early 2027 — one of the largest real-world tests of an AI cancer biomarker platform.

item.title: Aolani signs for 500MW of AI datacentre capacity in Malaysia — a 7× expansion of its GPU footprint by 2027
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Singapore neocloud Aolani has signed letters of intent for 500 megawatts of AI datacentre capacity across Malaysia, targeting online dates from the second half of 2027 and projecting up to 580MW committed by 2027.

item.title: Disney's Character.AI bill: $180 million for the people, $20 million for the tech — a court filing prices the team at 9× the code
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: A Delaware bankruptcy filing revealed Disney has budgeted about $180 million over three years to compensate the 66 Character.AI employees it hired — nine times its $20 million stalking-horse bid for the chatbot company's technology.

item.title: Make your agent draw diagrams worth publishing: a hands-on guide to diagram-design
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: cathrynlavery/diagram-design (57,687 stars, MIT) is an agent skill that turns plain-language requests into self-contained HTML+SVG diagrams in your brand — 45 diagram types, no shadows, no Mermaid slop. Hands-on: the one-command install, your first diagram, onboarding your brand colors, and exporting to SVG or PNG.
